title: httpCall for outbound API calls
why: Server code calls third-party APIs with timeouts, safe retries, size caps and private-target refusal without a fetch wrapper of its own.

adopt.snippet: const charge = await httpCall('https://payments.example.test/v1/charges', { method: 'POST', json: { amount: 10 }, idempotencyKey: 'order-1', timeout: 8000 })
